NAME: N Scottsdale/DC Ranch

FULL CHEF BIO:
For Chef Steven, the kitchen has always been a place of comfort, connection, and creativity. From a young age, he was drawn to the rhythms of cooking, often helping prepare meals during family gatherings instead of playing outside. That early passion evolved into a lifelong pursuit when he joined Fleming’s in 2011—his first official cooking job. Although Steven has no formal training, his culinary knowledge and technique have been shaped through experience, self-motivation, and an unwavering hunger to grow. After a brief break, he returned to Fleming’s in 2021, bringing renewed dedication and leadership to the team.

Steven is especially passionate about Italian cuisine, taking pride in the craft of homemade pasta, bread, and cheeses. He views cooking as an act of love and pours that philosophy into every plate. Whether he’s preparing a perfectly balanced Beef Carpaccio—his menu favorite—or inspiring his team to create dishes they'd proudly serve their own families. His kitchen is built on camaraderie, respect, and high standards, where he's side by side with his team through every service. Through the Chef’s Signature Series, Chef Steven continues to create exceptional dining experiences defined by soulful food, team spirit, and a genuine love for the culinary arts.

Chef Chris’s passion for the kitchen was sparked not by childhood dreams, but by real-world experience. With 15 years in the industry and a specialty in seafood, Chris takes a minimalist, product-first approach to food, allowing fresh ingredients to shine. One of his proudest dishes, a salmon risotto made with grano instead of arborio rice, highlights his creative adaptability and eye for efficiency.

Since joining Fleming’s nearly two years ago, Chef Chris has led his team with the mindset of a coach—setting clear expectations, following through with consistency, and empowering others to grow. He creates a culture that is interactive, organized, and always rooted in support, ensuring every team member knows they have opportunities to learn and advance. For Guests, his mission is simple: hospitality from the heart, with food that exceeds expectations from the moment they walk in. A devoted father who spends his free time sharing sports and hobbies with his son, Chris also draws inspiration from world-class dining experiences, like a memorable visit to Jean-Georges in Las Vegas. His favorite menu item, the USDA Prime Dry-Aged Ribeye, exemplifies the consistent quality he values most. Through the Chef’s Signature Series, Chef Chris continues to refine his craft while mentoring others, always driven by passion, purpose, and pride.
